name: Arba
overview: Arba is a male figure known in Scripture as the greatest man among the Anakim. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, he is recognized for his notable stature and significance within the biblical narrative. There are no additional personal details or notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Arba appears as a proper name in the Bible without an indicated meaning or divine origin. It is simply recorded as the name of this individual in Joshua 14:15.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Arba as the father of Anak in Joshua 15:13. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Arba's importance lies in his status as the greatest among the Anakim, a group known for their formidable presence. This distinction highlights his prominence and influence in the land during the time of the Israelite settlement. His legacy is further underscored through his son Anak, linking him to the broader narrative of the Anakim in the Old Testament.
